Marta K: Cutover in 35m — we can include the hotfix if PR merges. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/9145
Marta K: Needs 2x LGTM (security + eng). @sre-oncall @Jon H any chance for a quick second eye? :eyes:
Jon H: I can take a look in ~10m, ping me once CI is green.
CI Bot: PR 9145 — integration-tests failed on linux-x86 :x: 
Lee: Re-running the flaky suite now (`ci rerun --target=integration-tests`).
CI Bot: Re-run queued by Lee — started.
sre-oncall: FYI — if this misses the cutoff we'll have to push to tomorrow's window. Try to keep it minimal.
Jon H: Quick skim — does this change shard routing? diff looks small.
Marta K: Only kv-cache warmup tweak, no routing changes. Tested locally against canary traces.
Nina P: Left a tiny nit about a log message, non-blocking — giving first LGTM. :thumbsup:
Oli: reading now, will focus on the warmup semantics.
Oli: LGTM — semantics look correct and unit + integration pass locally. Approving. :white_check_mark:
Deploy Bot: Merge gate update — approvals=2/2, CI=green, ready to merge when you want.
Marta K: Merging now and kicking a 5-minute canary. If anything goes sideways we autobackout.
Jon H: Thanks — will watch traces, ping me if latency spikes. :shipit:
sre-oncall: Monitoring dashboards and traces on #eng-sre. I'll escalate on-call if the canary trips.
CI Bot: All checks passed — PR 9145 merged by Marta K.
Marta K: Included in this cut. Big thanks for the quick eyes, team. :tada:
